# The first review approves: one plan, one implement, one review, no fix round.
exec obee run 7
stdout 'item 7 finished after 0 fix rounds'

exec obee status
stdout '^item-7-r1\tdone$'

grep -count=1 '^plan 0 true a ' calls.log
grep -count=1 '^implement 0 true a ' calls.log
grep -count=1 '^review 0 true a ' calls.log
! grep '^implement [1-9]' calls.log

cmp events.log expected-events.log

-- verdicts --
approve
-- expected-events.log --
claim 7
ready 7
release 7
